verification.criterion: E_H[F(rho_out) - rho_out] < threshold_ha (and the residual estimate residual_bound_ha, an empirical estimator, not a bound, when BAANDI_STANDARD_RESIDUAL_GUARD=on); strict_criteria_met is information only
verification.note: delivered state is the converged step's own; a failed attempt continues SCF; work is also in the history entry's fixed_point_certificate

effective_cell_filter.meaning: G-MIXER-DIVERGENCE: replace plain Pulay by Kerker-Pulay only when the density basis has wavelengths longer than the equal-volume cube: q0^2 = max(0, (2*pi/volume^(1/3))^2 - min_nonzero_G^2); beta/history unchanged, charge mode removed, acceptance unchanged; replicated mixer (including on MPI), not a physical dielectric model
